reason: Entries and tooling that do not meet the editorial bar: fabricated metadata and mechanically generated prose

entries.name: Uiverse Design
entries.reason: Out of scope: a general-purpose CSS/Tailwind component library with no AI functionality, admitted by a newsletter sweep. Its own enrichment note recommended a keep/recategorize/remove review, and its last_commit (2026-06-13) did not match the repository's actual last push (2024-09-02).

Bulk generator that wrote invented metadata (hardcoded last_commit, estimated github_stars) and template prose into content/. Retired so it cannot be re-run: freshness and editorial rules both depend on those fields being measured, not guessed.
